metadata.remarks: The obligations that have applied since 2 February 2025 to every operator in scope, irrespective of risk classification: the Article 5 prohibitions and the Article 4 AI literacy duty, plus the scope and definition controls needed to determine applicability. This baseline is a precondition for every other profile in this repository. Two of the prohibitions it carries — Article 5(1)(ba) non-consensual intimate imagery and Article 5(1)(bb) child sexual abuse material — were inserted by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 and apply from 2 December 2026, not 2 February 2025; the Article 4 AI literacy duty was softened by the same regulation with effect from 27 July 2026, and Article 4a was inserted by it. An assessment against this profile must therefore record the assessment date, because three of its controls changed during 2026.
